description: Captained India to the ICC Under-19 World Cup title in Kuala Lumpur.
Part of the India side that won the ICC Cricket World Cup at the Wankhede, scoring 35 in the final.
Named ICC ODI Cricketer of the Year after 1,026 one-day runs in the calendar year.
Fastest batter to 5,000 ODI runs at the time, reaching the mark in 114 innings.
Player of the Tournament at the ICC World T20, 319 runs at an average of 106.33.
973 runs in a single IPL season -- still the highest tally by any batter in a men's IPL campaign.
Took Test captaincy full time and led India to the top of the ICC Test rankings.
Won the Sir Garfield Sobers Trophy as ICC Cricketer of the Year, along with the Test and ODI player awards.
Fastest to 20,000 international runs, needing only 417 innings.
Named ICC Male Cricketer of the Decade and captain of the ICC ODI and T20I Teams of the Decade.
Ended a 1,020-day wait for an international hundred with 122 not out against Afghanistan in the Asia Cup.
Record 765 runs at a single ODI World Cup, including a 50th ODI century on his 35th birthday.
Player of the Match in the T20 World Cup final in Barbados, then retired from the format as a world champion.
Won the ICC Champions Trophy in Dubai and passed 14,000 ODI runs in the same tournament.
